Verify rewrite DATA ONLY. Do not write improved examples or solve the user's task.
Read every input and target in full. Return one review per exact id and row_sha256.
input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

network latency before approving the cluster configuration rollout.", "output": "We are experiencing severe partition skew across our distributed Redis cache cluster during peak evening traffic surges. Please inspect `ring_router.go` in the routing directory and check `vnode_store.rs` in the storage engine package. When cache nodes join or leave the consistent hash ring, the ring router distributes virtual node tokens across 300 hash slots. During cluster rebalancing operations, the token migration routine stalls because synchronous replication locks vnode partitions during state transfer. We must configure the cache replication factor to 3 replicas per partition and implement asynchronous background reconciliation. Furthermore, update the socket connection timeout to 400 ms and set the maximum replication backlog buffer to 128 MB. Ensure that client request hedging queries secondary replicas whenever primary replica response latency exceeds 50 ms. The cluster coordinator must also track partition memory usage across 15-second evaluation intervals, isolating unbalanced vnode replicas before cache misses trigger upstream database bottlenecks. In addition, update the gossip protocol heartbeats in `cluster_state.go` to send ping probes every 250 ms and mark lagging storage nodes as degraded when 4 consecutive ping attempts fail. Operators must ensure that cache eviction policies enforce volatile-lru algorithms, preventing unexpired customer session keys from being purged during memory spikes. Review `memory_manager.cpp` to verify that jemalloc background threads purge dirty pages when heap fragmentation exceeds 20%. Site reliability engineers must monitor p99 cache lookup latencies on the primary Grafana dashboard, keeping overall response times under 15 ms during cluster rebalancing. If a secondary replica becomes unresponsive for more than 60 seconds, the cluster manager must trigger automatic node eviction and redistribute virtual hash tokens to standby compute instances. The backup replication coordinator in `snapshot_coordinator.py` must also capture incremental RDB snapshots every 6 hours, saving compressed binary dumps to encrypted object storage. To guarantee zero data loss during unplanned hardware faults, the storage subsystem must maintain write ahead logging on local NVMe drives, syncing log buffers every 10 ms. Network interfaces across all cache server nodes must enable jumbo frames with 9000-byte MTUs to eliminate TCP packet fragmentation under high throughput workloads. The security operations team also mandates enforcing TLS 1.3 with mutual client certificate validation across all inter-node replication channels. Cluster operators must never restart primary nodes without initiating manual graceful connection handoffs to secondary instances. Finally, the distributed systems infrastructure team requires automated benchmark verification demonstrating 20,000 write requests per second under simulated network latency before approving the cluster configuration rollout."}]
